cards.ex: I managed to wake up on time despite the power outage.
cards.exUz: Elektr uzilishiga qaramay, vaqtida uyg'onishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan vaqtda uyg'onmoq.

cards.ex: Please don't disturb my sleep; I need to rest.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, uxlashimga xalaqit bermang; dam olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir uxlash jarayonini buzmoq yoki xalaqit bermoq.

cards.ex: His plans felt more like a waking dream than reality.
cards.exUz: Uning rejalari haqiqatdan ko'ra hushidagi tushga o'xshardi.
cards.uzDef: Hayolda ro'y beradigan fantaziya yoki xayoliy voqea.

cards.ex: The government was asleep at the wheel during the crisis.
cards.exUz: Hukumat inqiroz paytida e'tiborsiz edi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim vaziyatda e'tiborsiz yoki beparvo bo'lish.

cards.ex: Rise and shine, everyone! It's a beautiful day.
cards.exUz: Uyg'oning, hamma! Bugun ajoyib kun.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni uyg'onishga va kunni boshlashga undash.

cards.ex: You think you'll win the lottery? Only in your dreams!
cards.exUz: Siz lotereyada yutasiz deb o'ylaysizmi? Faqat tushingizda!
cards.uzDef: Bu amalga oshmaydi degan ma'noni bildiradi

cards.ex: The accident was a wake-up call to drive more carefully.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisa ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydash uchun ogohlantiruvchi qo'ng'iroq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan, muammo yoki xavf haqida ogohlantiruvchi voqea.

cards.ex: He's already in the land of nod.
cards.exUz: U allaqachon uyqu diyorida.
cards.uzDef: Uyqu holatini tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladigan ibora.

cards.ex: I'm dead tired after that hike; I'm going straight to bed.
cards.exUz: O'sha piyoda sayrdan keyin juda charchadim; to'g'ri yotog'imga boraman.
cards.uzDef: Juda ham charchagan, holdan toygan holatni bildiradi.

cards.ex: She lost consciousness briefly after the accident, but thankfully she's okay now.
cards.exUz: U baxtsiz hodisadan keyin qisqa vaqtga hushidan ketdi, lekin xursandchilik bilan hozir yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yo'qotish, hushsiz holatga tushish.

cards.ex: During a REM cycle, your brain activity increases, and you're more likely to dream.
cards.exUz: REM sikli davomida miyangizning faolligi oshadi va tush ko'rishingiz ehtimoli ko'proq.
cards.uzDef: Tez ko'z harakati sikli, uyqu bosqichi.

cards.ex: I'm going to get some kip before the party tonight; I need to recharge.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun bo'ladigan ziyofatdan oldin ozgina uxlab olaman; quvvat olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa muddatli uxlash, dam olish.

cards.ex: I tossed and turned all night; I couldn't get comfortable.
cards.exUz: Men kechasi bilan ag'darilib chiqdim; o'zimni qulay his qila olmadim.
cards.uzDef: Kechasi bilan tinimsiz ag'darilib, uxlay olmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit faint; I think I need to have a lie down.
cards.exUz: O'zimni biroz hushsiz his qilyapman; o'ylashimcha, biroz yotib dam olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biroz vaqtga yotib dam olish.

cards.ex: She's a light sleeper, so try not to make any noise when you come in.
cards.exUz: U sezgir uquvchi, shuning uchun kirganingizda shovqin qilmaslikka harakat qiling.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday shovqinga tezda uyg'onib ketadigan odam.

cards.ex: We live in a sleep-deprived society where people prioritize work over rest.
cards.exUz: Biz odamlar dam olishdan ko'ra ishga ustunlik beradigan uyqusiz jamiyatda yashaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Uyquga to'ymaydigan, kam uxlaydigan jamiyat.

cards.ex: REM dreams are often the most vivid and bizarre.
cards.exUz: REM tushlari ko'pincha eng yorqin va g'alati bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: REM bosqichida ko'rilgan tush.

cards.ex: You could set off a bomb next to him, and he wouldn't wake up; he's such a heavy sleeper!
cards.exUz: Uning yonida bomba portlatsangiz ham, u uyg'onmaydi; u shunchalik qattiq uxlaydi!
cards.uzDef: Shovqinga befarq, qattiq uxlaydigan odam.

cards.ex: After the marathon, I was out cold within minutes of getting home.
cards.exUz: Marafon tugaganidan keyin, uyga yetib kelganimdan bir necha daqiqa ichida hushsiz yotdim.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur uyquda bo'lish, hushsiz holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The boundary between reality and imagination blurs in a dream state.
cards.exUz: Tush holatida haqiqat va xayol o'rtasidagi chegara xiralashadi.
cards.uzDef: Tush ko'rish paytidagi ong holati.

cards.ex: He's a chronic insomniac and struggles to get more than a few hours of sleep each night.
cards.exUz: U surunkali uyqusizlikka chalingan va har kecha bir necha soatdan ortiq uxlay olmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda uyqusizlikdan aziyat chekadigan odam.

cards.ex: She takes sleeping pills to help her manage her insomnia.
cards.exUz: U uyqusizligini davolashga yordam berish uchun uyqu dorilarini qabul qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Uyquni keltiradigan dori vositalari.

cards.ex: I usually take a power nap during my lunch break to recharge for the afternoon.
cards.exUz: Men odatda tushlik paytida peshin uchun quvvat olish uchun energetik uxlashni amalga oshiraman.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida kuch beradigan uxlash.

cards.ex: Because of the new baby, we're sleeping in shifts to make sure someone is always awake.
cards.exUz: Yangi chaqaloq tufayli, kimdir doimo uyg'oq bo'lishi uchun biz smenada uxlayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Navbatchilik asosida uxlash, bir necha bo'lakka bo'lib uxlash.

cards.ex: I'm running on a sleep deficit after working all weekend.
cards.exUz: Men dam olish kunlari ishlaganimdan keyin uyqu tanqisligida ishlayapman.
cards.uzDef: Yetarli uxlamaslik natijasida yuzaga keladigan holat.

cards.ex: I've turned my bedroom into a sleep sanctuary with blackout curtains and a comfortable mattress.
cards.exUz: Men yotoqxonamni qora parda va qulay matras bilan uyqu maskaniga aylantirdim.
cards.uzDef: Uyqu uchun qulay va tinch joy.

cards.ex: The child experienced night terrors that scared the whole family.
cards.exUz: Bola butun oilani qo'rqitadigan kechki vahimalarni boshdan kechirdi.
cards.uzDef: Kechasi uyg'onib ketib, qo'rqinchli holatga tushish.

cards.ex: Good sleep hygiene includes avoiding caffeine before bed and maintaining a regular sleep schedule.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi uyqu gigienasi uyqudan oldin kofeindan qochish va muntazam uyqu jadvalini saqlashni o'z ichiga oladi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi uyquga erishish uchun qilinadigan odatlar.

cards.ex: After a night of sleep deprivation, you might experience a REM rebound.
cards.exUz: Uyqusiz tun o'tkazganingizdan so'ng, siz REM qaytarilishini boshdan kechirishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: REM uyqusi yetishmaganidan keyin ko'proq REM uyqusini ko'rish.

cards.ex: Sleep apnea can lead to serious health problems if left untreated.
cards.exUz: Uyqu apnesi davolanmasa, jiddiy sog'liq muammolariga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Uyqu paytida nafas olish to'xtashi.
